selected_evidence.requirement: Inventory logs from node2 are centrally collected and persisted on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the active TCP collector, established forwarding connection, destination file metadata, and received inventory records before and after restarts.
Captures healthy baseline boot ID, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered listener, retained data, and delivery of a message queued during the outage.
Captures healthy sender baseline and delivered marker, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered enabled rsyslog service and TCP connection, and successful post-restart delivery.
